purpose: Quick-reference operator commands for observing, selecting, and rolling back the Agent V2 backend

set_langgraph_session.description: Opt in to LangGraph for the current PowerShell session only

set_native_session.description: Return to Native for the current PowerShell session only

unset_backend_session.description: Remove AGENT_V2_BACKEND from the current session (Native default)

probe_runtime_backend.description: Instantiate the selector and print the chosen backend and fallback state
probe_runtime_backend.powershell: python -c "from brain_v9.core.agent_kernel_v2.runtime import get_agent_runtime_v2; rt=get_agent_runtime_v2(); print(rt.backend, getattr(rt, 'backend_selected', 'n/a'), getattr(rt, 'backend_fallback_used', 'n/a'), getattr(rt, 'backend_fallback_reason', 'n/a'))"

probe_backend_name_only.description: Print the resolved backend name without instantiating a runtime

start_server_native.description: Start Brain V9 with Native default

start_server_langgraph.description: Start Brain V9 with LangGraph opt-in

dashboard_agent_v2_status.description: Query the dashboard agent v2 status endpoint

run_selector_guard_smoke.description: Run the runtime selector guard smoke tests (Native default contract)

run_langgraph_contract_smoke.description: Run the LangGraph backend contract smoke tests

run_langgraph_failure_mode_smoke.description: Run the LangGraph failure-mode hardening smoke tests

run_dashboard_token_smoke.description: Run the dashboard chat proxy token smoke tests

hygiene_check_dry_run.description: Run the no-sensitive-paths hygiene check without staging
